name: Tarock Königrufen (Austrian)
description: KÃ¶nigrufen (Call the King) is the 'queen of card games' in Austria. It is a 4-player Tarot game with a 54-card deck. The defining feature is the 'calling' mechanic where a declarer chooses a partner by calling a King suit. There are numerous contracts ranging from simple games to complex negative bids (Bettel) and high-value solos.

history.origins: The Tarock family emerged in Northern Italy during the Early Renaissance (first evidenced 1440). From the mid-18th century in the German-speaking world and Habsburg monarchy, reforms added bidding (from L'Hombre and Quadrille), the 54-card pack, talon exchange, and the bonus when the lowest trump (Trump I) wins the last trick. Königrufen first appears in 1827 as a four-player variant of Tapp Tarock in an appendix to the Tarok Tappen rulebook; the first book devoted solely to Königrufen was published in Vienna in 1840. The game boomed between 1880 and 1920 and gained more contracts throughout the 20th century. It is played across Austria and South Tyrol and by 2015 had become the favourite card game of Austrians.
timeline: 1827: First written description of Königrufen (Tarok Tappen appendix).
1840: First book devoted to Königrufen published in Vienna.
1880–1920: Boom period; four-bid structure and growth of regional play.
history.cultural: National card game of Austria; stronghold in Upper Austria; viewed in Austrian law as a game of skill; annual championship in Casino Linz.
history.evolution: Evolved from Tapp Tarock with partner-calling from Quadrille; 20th-century addition of negative contracts (e.g. Piccolo) and bird bonuses; today 13 contracts and 8 bonuses in Austrian Final rules.

rules.objective: Win enough points (usually 36) or fulfill contract.
rules.gameplay: Bidding for contract (Rufer, Solo, Bettel, etc.). Declarer calls a King (unless Solo). Partner not revealed until King is played (or other rule). Play: Must follow suit. Must trump if void. Highest Tarock wins.
keyRules: Call a King to pick partner
Talon exchange allowed in lower contracts
Sküs, Mond, and Trump I are Trull (5 pts each)

strategy.basic: Bid carefully. Support partner. Count Trumps.
strategy.intermediate: Pagat Ultimo (Playing Trump I on last trick).
strategy.advanced: Signal via discards. Manage Talon exchange optimaly.
